value.rationale: The new power-law nonlinear hindrance family is a natural extension of the classical RFM; exact approach of throughput to its infinite-chain limit is useful for finite-length performance estimates. The full interior cotangent profile reveals order-1/n spatial nonuniformity that is invisible in the limiting current and arises through a dynamical bottleneck. Neither outcome is merely a renaming of saddle-node scaling; the transport-specific coefficient and observable limit require nontrivial orbit reconstruction.
